en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Main goal of the course is practical skills development oriented on problems of landscape planning. Special accent is put on development of creativity, increasing knowledge about conceptual landscape planning and collaborative planning skills development. Final output is the case study of real area made by students team.
